title: Ordinary scalar extension commutes with pro-etale slice restriction
statement: For a scheme X, a pro-etale object U, and a map f:R -> S of sheaves of commutative rings, the ordinary scalar-extension functor on the slice obtained from the universal witness completedAdicSliceChange is naturally isomorphic to the composite of completedAdicChange with the exact slice restriction functor on S-modules.

source.place: lemma-derived-base-change (06YY), ordinary tensor and sheafification portion

proof.text: Use the normalized object and morphism equations of the two scalar-extension witnesses to identify each chosen ordinary functor with the sheafification of the explicit sectionwise extension-of-scalars functor. The comparison is eqToIso on each object; the witness morphism equation proves naturality.

On an object V -> U, both scalar-extension presheaves have the same tensor module. The identity on pure tensors is compatible with restriction because the characterization of each changeOfRingsMap restricts the scalar and module factors. Tensor induction proves compatibility for all sections, and the component identities are natural in module morphisms.

The sheafification adjunction gives the comparison from the sheafification of a restricted module presheaf to the restriction of its sheafification. Its composite with the slice sheafification unit is the restricted original unit. The original unit is locally bijective, and this remains true after restriction to the slice. Cancellation of the locally bijective slice unit shows the comparison is locally bijective, hence an isomorphism of module sheaves. Naturality follows by sheafification extensionality and the naturality of the unit. Compose this with the preceding presheaf and normalization isomorphisms.
